name: imfd-marketplace
description: Private Claude Code marketplace for the IMFD team: shared skills, agents, and connectors that standardize how we develop.

plugins.name: dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Development activity skills, named by area: backend/frontend contract handoffs, layered scaffolding, and auditing existing code against the team standard.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Team standard for the repository lifecycle: commit messages (Platanus convention), PR descriptions, and pre-merge review.

plugins.name: marketplace-authoring
plugins.description: Meta-tooling to create and modify the marketplace itself: scaffold plugins, skills, subagents, and MCP connectors, then validate and audit before publishing.

plugins.name: team-standards
plugins.description: Injects the team's coding standards, PR conventions, and architecture patterns into every session as persistent context (SessionStart hook), and installs the mechanical pre-commit checks that enforce them.
